claim.scope: Bounded Metal attention through 4096 positions, advisory frame-budget arithmetic and live plan-only admission/rejection, explicitly managed DAC scratch with observed output/resource regressions, unchanged upstream frontier and stable shared-uniform native prefix.
excluded: Physical-memory reservation, peak bound or OOM guarantee
1100/2048 full model-generation steps or upstream trajectory parity
Full DAC numeric parity or silence/acting/voice quality repair
No existing host control reads, initial uploads or completion waits
LTP/WBA certificate or unrelated Qwen changes

risk_and_rollback.strongest_failure: Overwriting a live residual/diagnostic alias or releasing resources before GPU completion; optimistic advisory sizing under GC retention and changing host load.
risk_and_rollback.guards: Backing-handle exclusions, serial tracked queue, immutable trace bypass, existing completion drain before release, uncertain-drain quarantine, depth0/2 exact probes, checked byte products and per-buffer limits.
risk_and_rollback.rollback: DRAMA3_DAC_SCRATCH=0 and manual <=1024 total positions; omit experimental auto flags or revert this feature commit.

runtime.execution: Serial run_safe, private mmap, unchanged reduction flags, allocation profiling enabled in both paired variants. Shared-host timings are exploratory.

allocation_contract.scope: Once per decode; reuse across decoder layers only. Final mono and traced activations use separate storage.
allocation_contract.successful_release: Explicit after existing finish; uncertain error drain quarantines for process lifetime.
allocation_contract.existing_persistent: Backbone recurrent state and backbone/tower caches.
allocation_contract.remaining_gc: Other Context.alloc buffers, wrappers, metadata and host output construction.

results.scope: Observed regression and resource results; not a speedup, physical-memory guarantee, silence repair or full upstream parity certificate.

native_generation.scope: EOS before the old 1024-position execution boundary. Wide allocation/path exercised; actual long lengths are separately covered by synthetic GPU tests.

prefix_comparison.scope: Exact terminal ID equality on GPU for the previously shared-uniform prefix. No new upstream generation, waveform or full trajectory parity claim.

first_live_probe.scope: Advisory estimate; no memory was reserved and no model inference ran.

final_live_probe.scope: Advisory allocation estimate; shared-host load and GC retention can change the actual peak.

verification.pre_fix_per_buffer_falsifier: 10 valid examples, 2 failures, 0 errors for omitted convolution history and doubled full-attention q projection; final 17-example CPU suite passes.
discarded_inconclusive_runs: First per-buffer fixture had invalid tower geometry; its errors are not a falsifier.
Initial external sampler proof failed to compile because Slice#first returned Array(UInt8); bounded slicing fixed the probe only.

adversary.scope: Observed narrow regression, lifetime, arithmetic and resource results. Correlated mini-Quadrumvirate plus root-executed tests; not independent model agreement.
failed_promotions: No speedup: both paired arena timings slower by 22-32 percent; shared-host cause remains unknown.
No physical peak guarantee: GC/driver retention and host load not certified.
No complete upstream parity: prior DAC stage and generation forks remain.
adversary.next_discriminator: Interleaved fresh/arena timing at fixed depth with matched warmups, per-command GPU timing and host encoding timing before optimizing broader workspace ownership.

lineage.binding: Latest Metal build source hashes and focused spec hashes match current files. Paired decoder/Context/kernel/bridge source hashes match current files; later inventory/budget repairs do not run on the paired DAC path. Raw command manifest carries all build/run input hashes.
lineage.decay_trigger: Refresh on production source, shader, checkpoint, fixture/tape, runtime/device/OS, graph policy, precision or tolerance change.
